_usage: Copy to config_metadata.json, fill in your values, then run: python tableau_metadata_api_extractor.py --config config_metadata.json
_credential_options: Option A (RECOMMENDED) — leave username and password blank here.
The script will prompt you securely at runtime (password is never echoed).
Option B — set TABLEAU_USERNAME and TABLEAU_PASSWORD environment variables.
Option C — fill in username/password below (not recommended for shared machines).

_notes.server_url: Your Tableau Server URL, e.g. https://tableau.yourcompany.com — no trailing slash
_notes.api_version: Tableau Server 2023.3 uses REST API version 3.21. Check via: https://<server>/api/2.3/serverinfo
_notes.username: Leave blank to be prompted at runtime. Or set TABLEAU_USERNAME env var.
_notes.password: Leave blank to be prompted securely at runtime. Or set TABLEAU_PASSWORD env var. Never store plaintext passwords in shared config files.
_notes.site_content_url: Use 'all' to scan every site. Use '' (empty string) f
